sloka: तस्यां रजन्यां व्युष्टायां प्रातर्नृपतिबोधकाः ।वन्दिनः समुपातिष्ठन्सौम्या नृपतिवेश्मनि ।। ७.३७.२ ॥
transliteration: tasyāṁ rajanyāṁ vyuṣṭāyāṁ prātarnṛpatibodhakāḥ ।vandinaḥ samupātiṣṭhansaumyā nṛpativeśmani ।। 7.37.2 ॥

translations.english: As that night dawned, in the morning, gentle bards, who were the awakeners of the king, stood near the king's palace.
